title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Early Acceptance Bonus Table
content:
An early-acceptance bonus is added to a Commercial Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit by how far ahead of the contract end date the offer is accepted, counted in calendar days from the acceptance date to the contract end date:

| Calendar days from the acceptance date to the contract end date | Early-acceptance bonus |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | $25.00 |
| From 1 up to 20 | $10.00 |
| 0, acceptance on the contract end date itself | None |

The early-acceptance bonus is added to the loyalty credit after the base credit has been multiplied, and the bonus itself is not multiplied.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical contract end date 2025-12-31)

| Acceptance date | Days ahead | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-12-01 | 30 | $25.00 |
| 2025-12-10 | 21 | $25.00 |
| 2025-12-11 | 20 | $10.00 |
| 2025-12-30 | 1 | $10.00 |
| 2025-12-31 | 0 | None |
